title: Arriving 'gods' will be received as saviours, leading to Armageddon
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Arriving 'gods' will be received as saviours, leading to Armageddon, about future at Earth, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And that that group will be received as the gods returning to the earth.

plain: A filmmaker and researcher named Tim Alberino, who made a film called Birthright, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that a group of beings will one day arrive on Earth and be welcomed as the gods returning. Drawing on the Book of Revelation, the last book of the Bible, he links this arrival to the road toward Armageddon, the final battle. In his view it would mean humanity mistakes these arrivals for saviours.
